historical_migrations.failure_and_repair: The V49 image seed registered an ordinary object before owa_artifacts existed. The final candidate counts OWA artifact references for OWA-owned objects only and passes the failed node.

candidate_regression.scope: Object storage suite, historical V50 tool-image upgrade, OWA publication/subscription/revocation integration, desktop capture schema snapshot restore.

verified_contracts: The production Router records directed reader grants. Publication refuses ungranted readers, deduplicates retries, rejects mismatched idempotency keys and checks version CAS.
The verifier gets one notice for the newest version. Unsubscribing after publication invalidates older unacknowledged notices, and restart does not duplicate delivery.
The old version is retained in storage but is no longer accepted by read_shared. The valid reader initially sees the current bytes.
Owner revocation during physical read makes the post-read authorization reject the content. The other reader grant persists.

The wrong main session cannot revoke a share. Generic object listing and direct download exclude OWA private objects. Erasing the source removes current artifact metadata from the main Ticket projection.
Fresh and V53 through V59 fixture databases pass integrity and foreign-key checks. V2 object collection and offline desktop and Android capture regressions pass.
